summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Homeland Security to verify personal and biometric information and conduct in-person vetting for all individuals evacuated from Afghanistan between January 20, 2021, and January 20, 2022, and prohibits those who do not comply from receiving federal assistance.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses entirely on requiring verification and vetting of individuals evacuated from Afghanistan, including personal and biometric information, in-person interviews, and restricting federal benefits for those who do not comply. This directly relates to securing borders by ensuring proper vetting of individuals who have entered the country.
